x: Perhaps the most promising Field Events man of the season is young Peter Nunn who, in his first Javelin competition against Dorking and Whitgift, threw 167 ft. 7 ins. with a junior Javelin.
Alan Lomas was at the Hall recently, and is still with the R.A.F. Peter Nunn has been recently called up, and is stationed at Durham.
